title: Resolve lore instructions agents vs bare lore init: the documented Claude default is not what init.ts does
description: Routed by opum-agent OPAG-421, ADR gap 2 (opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md (Amendments 1-4)). src/core/instructions.ts:~366 says 'lore init with no bridge flag and no prior selection still bootstraps Claude by default'; src/commands/init.ts:~874 calls applyAgentsBridge only when parsed.agents is set, so a bare non-interactive lore init creates no Claude bridge. Which side changes is lore-cli's call per the ADR. Decide by what the wizard, ADR-0017 and the cli-surface docs promise, and by whether a default bridge write would conflict with the marketplace check (a bare init selects no target, so it would have no plugin check to run).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The documented and coded default for a bare lore init agree, with the choice and its reason recorded on this task
A test pins the agreed behaviour of a bare non-interactive lore init with respect to the Claude bridge, and the lore instructions agents text matches it
